body:
Adds `research/eiv-twin`: errors-in-variables attenuation of a digital-twin gain fitted from a noisy logged input.

- Exact reliability-ratio law (0.800 vs 0.802 simulated), twin's own 95% interval covers the true gain 53% → 0% as n grows 20 → 200, residuals give no warning, feedforward overshoot exactly 1/λ.
- Repairs (known-noise correction, instrumental variable) with their costs and small-n failure reported.
- 5 unit tests pass; `python site/build.py` prints ok; README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry added.
